messages:
mira: heads-up — main is red on CI, failing e2e 'scheduler_backoff_test' on multiple shards. seen in 3/5 runs. https://ci.redwood.internal/12345 :grimacing: Can someone help bisect?

ci-bot: Build 12345 failed on commit abcdef3 (refs/heads/main). Failed job: e2e/scheduler_backoff_test (shard 2). Log excerpt:
```
--- FAIL: TestSchedulerBackoff (0.02s)
    scheduler_backoff_test.go:47: expected 0 retries, got 3
    runtime/runtime.go:123: context deadline exceeded
```

alex: copying logs. do we have a likely last-green for these e2es? or a suspect PR?

sam: last-green for e2e on main was commit 9f4a1c (runs green 2026-03-10 08:12 UTC). suspect area: scheduler retry/backoff defaults changed in PR #4721 last week.

jin: @sam I flagged #4721 as risky in review but it merged. It touched backoff config + a small change to the scheduler test harness.

alex: ok can we bisect range 9f4a1c..abcdef3? I can spin a local bisect if someone posts the bisect command.

sam: try: `git bisect start abcdef3 9f4a1c` then `git bisect run ./ci/scripts/run_e2e.sh e2e/scheduler_backoff_test --shard=2` — that's what I used before.

mira: running that now on an m5-large runner, will report back.

(ci-bot): ci-runner started for mira (job id 9876)...

mira: first few bisect steps done, failing on commit 2b7d3e which includes some unrelated doc changes. continuing...

sam: docs-only shouldn't affect behavior, weird. keep going.

mira: bisect narrowed to commit 4721a99 — this is the merge commit for PR #4721.

alex: nice, that pins it. can someone confirm the exact change? jin, you reviewed — was there a default timeout/backoff change?

jin: yes PR #4721 increased the default backoff multiplier from 1.0 -> 2.5 for scheduler retries and also removed a short-circuit in the test harness that previously avoided retries in unit test mode. That combination could explain extra retries observed.

sam: that matches failure (expected 0 retries). test relied on no retries; with multiplier higher we get retries and timing issues. We should revert the merge ASAP to unbreak main and then follow up with a test fix + config toggle.

mira: agree. I'll open a hotfix revert PR against main reverting the merge commit 4721a99. Alex can you add revert PR to release-oncall and tag ops?

alex: on it — opening revert PR now. PR will be: revert/4721-revert-scheduler-backoff. adding changelog and note to run full e2e.

ci-bot: New PR opened: https://git.redwood/internal/pulls/4799 (revert of 4721a99) — CI triggered.

sam: once CI passes on revert we should merge and cut a quick deployment. I'll coordinate with oncall.

mira: thanks all — great triage. After revert, let's add a focused unit test that asserts zero-retry behavior under test harness and add a config flag so production backoff stays tunable.

alex: noted, I'll also add a follow-up issue to track proper fix (assign to jin + sam).

jin: thanks. :thumbsup:

mira: closing the loop here — revert PR CI passed and merged, main green again. leaving follow-ups in issue #4890. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
